# Delivery template - Wrong date

In the delivery PDF template the date displayed in the header is the invoice date and not the delivery date.
Exemple : 
My customer create an order the third of march (2022-03-03) the paiement is OK so there is an order invoice created at the same date.
The order is prepared by the service the fourth of march (2022-03-04), so the status order is «Preparation in progress» and the order invoic is updated to set the delivery_date at 2022-03-04.
At this point, the order was created the third, the invoice date is the third and the delivery date is the fourth.

When I download the delivery slip pdf, the header date is not the delivery date but the invoice date.

## Attendu
The date in the delivery slip PDF has to be the date of the delivery slip and not of the invoice slip …
The template should use the delivery_date on the OrderInvoic object instead of the creation date.

## Étapes
1 - Create an order with teh status «Accepted paiment»
2 - Wait until the next day
3 - Change the order status to generate a delivery slip
4 - Download the delivery slip.
5 - The date (in the top right) is the invoice date not the delivery slip date …

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
